entities.name: Second Talite Crusade
entities.description: Campaign led by the Church of Tal after the failed Siege of Penregon, which cleared eastern Terisiare of 'machine demons'.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: City the Talites besieged and returned to.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Urza's most important base, spared after its artifacts were destroyed.

entities.name: Mishra's Fortress
entities.description: Mishra's greatest base, site of fierce fighting.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Warned the Talites of the mist around the tower.

entities.name: Raddic
entities.description: Talite leader who swore to tear down the tower and died at Mishra's Fortress.

events.summary: The Talites regrouped after the failed siege and marched away vowing to return.
events.quote: marching away from the city while vowing to return at a later date

events.summary: The Talites destroyed artifacts in Urza's Tower but left the building standing.
events.quote: the Talites instead destroyed any artifacts inside the tower but left the building itself standing

events.summary: The Talites fought fiercely at Mishra's Fortress, killing the demons; Raddic died.
The Talites returned to Penregon to find it abandoned.
events.quote: the civils that had once populated its streets had all left

events.summary: The second crusade ended with eastern Terisiare liberated.
